description: Complete analysis and ready tests for every AC.

analysis.summary: Cart line management: add, change quantity within 1-10, remove, and subtotal maths.

acceptance_criteria.text: Clicking "Add to cart" on an in-stock product adds one unit of it to the cart.
The quantity of a cart line can be changed to any whole number from 1 to 10.
Removing a cart line deletes it and updates the cart subtotal immediately.
The cart subtotal equals the sum of unit price multiplied by quantity for every line.

findings.text: Does adding a product that is already in the cart create a second line or increase the quantity?
Behaviour when adding an out-of-stock product is not specified.

risks.title: Subtotal rounding error
risks.description: Decimal prices multiplied by quantity may be rounded incorrectly.

risks.title: Invalid quantity accepted
risks.description: Out-of-range quantities could reach the order.

assumptions: Prices are shown in EUR with two decimals.

test_cases.title: Add to cart adds one unit of an in-stock product
test_cases.objective: Verify: Add to cart adds one unit of an in-stock product.

steps.action: Open the product page of an in-stock product and click "Add to cart".
steps.expected_result: The cart shows one line for Demo Mug with quantity 1.

test_cases.title: Quantity accepts the boundary values 1 and 10
test_cases.objective: Verify: Quantity accepts the boundary values 1 and 10.

steps.action: Set the Demo Mug line quantity to 10.
Set the Demo Mug line quantity to 1.

test_cases.title: Quantity outside 1 to 10 is not applied
test_cases.objective: Verify: Quantity outside 1 to 10 is not applied.
preconditions: Cart contains Demo Mug with quantity 1.

steps.action: Set the Demo Mug line quantity to 11.
steps.expected_result: The line quantity stays at its previous value of 1.

steps.action: Set the Demo Mug line quantity to 0.
steps.expected_result: The line quantity stays at its previous value of 1.

test_cases.title: Removing a line updates the subtotal immediately
test_cases.objective: Verify: Removing a line updates the subtotal immediately.
preconditions: Cart contains Demo Mug and Demo Pen, quantity 1 each.

steps.action: Remove the Demo Mug line from a cart with Demo Mug (5.00) and Demo Pen (2.50).
steps.expected_result: The Demo Mug line disappears and the subtotal shows 2.50 without reloading the page.

test_cases.title: Subtotal sums unit price times quantity across lines
test_cases.objective: Verify: Subtotal sums unit price times quantity across lines.

steps.action: Open the cart with Demo Mug x3 at 4.99 and Demo Pen x2 at 0.35.

test_cases.title: Non-numeric quantity input is rejected
test_cases.objective: Verify: Non-numeric quantity input is rejected.
preconditions: Cart contains Demo Mug with quantity 1.

steps.action: Type "abc" into the Demo Mug quantity field and confirm.
steps.expected_result: The quantity field shows a validation message and the line quantity stays 1.
